Maya R.: @here quick heads-up — short all-hands this Thu 9:00am PT (30m). Need final slides by Wed EOD. Agenda below and a shared Q doc for collection. Please tag any blockers.

Maya R.: Agenda (high level): 1) Exec priorities (5m) 2) Launch callouts + go/no-go checklist (10m) 3) Infra health & SLAs (5m) 4) Demo (5m) 5) Q&A (5m) — keep calls crisp.

Alex G.: I'll cover the exec priorities and the two hire announcements — 5m, no slides needed.

Sam P.: I'll surface latency/cost numbers for the Dedicated rollout and the fallback plan. Will attach 2 slides.

Lena V.: Can we include a 2-minute demo of the feature toggles? I can run it live if infra is green.

Jin L.: Uploading my deck to the shared folder now -> https://drive.internal/redwood/allhands/mar-2026. Slides will be thumbnail-only for the demo.

Cecilia (People Ops): I'll send a calendar update with captions and recording consent note. Also please add any accessibility requests to the doc.

Maya R.: Q collection doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/allhands/questions-2026-03-25 — drop bullets, not essays. We'll triage for the live Q&A.

Sam P.: Quick note on callouts: please add any known customer impact + mitigation steps to slide 3 so support has talking points.

Lena V.: Added demo checklist and a rollback slide. @Maya R. flagged one dependency on the feature flag service.

Maya R.: Thanks — @Jin L. can you confirm the flag service is in the last pass?

Jin L.: Flag service is green in staging, smoke pass scheduled Wed 2pm PT. If it fails, we flip to fallback path and pause deploy.

DeployBot: Reminder scheduled — All-hands (Thu 9:00am PT) created and a 15m reminder will post in channel 30m before the meeting.

Alex G.: Two asks: 1) 1 slide on risk+rollback, 2) a single slide with the success metric we'll use to decide go/no-go.

Maya R.: Perfect. Everyone — please keep slides to 1-2 bullets per slide. Upload by Wed EOD or ping me if you need more time.

Sam P.: Uploaded infra slides. Also added the SLA targets and a short note on expected token cost increase during ramp.

Cecilia (People Ops): Recording link will be posted after the meeting in #all-hands and Drive; I'll add the link here once available.

Lena V.: Added demo runbook to the doc. Will rehearse Tue 11am with Jin.

Maya R.: Appreciate the quick turnaround. If you want a slot in the 5m Q&A please state it here. Otherwise we'll pick questions from the doc.

Alex G.: I'll take the first Q slot if any product questions come up.

Sam P.: I'll take infra ops Qs.

Jin L.: Rehearse invite sent to demo team — included rollback checklist.

Maya R.: Great. Thanks everyone — see you Thu. :rocket:

Sam P.: Added one last note in the Q doc about API deprecation timeline.

Cecilia (People Ops): Calendar update sent with captions and recording consent. If you didn't get it DM me.

Lena V.: Sounds good, thanks! :thumbsup:

Jin L.: All set from my side.

DeployBot: Recording will be available at https://redwood.internal/recordings/allhands-2026-03-25 after the meeting.
